resources.string:
Please place your Harvest Moon: Back to Nature game disc image (.bin / .cue) into:

Internal Storage > Documents > VanillaBTN

Accepted filenames: game.bin, hmbtn.bin, VanillaBTN.bin, or your disc image name.
Storage access is required to load save data and game disc image.

Game disc image (.bin / .cue / .iso) is required to play.\n\nPlease select your USA game disc file. It will be copied to secure app storage so your save files and settings work seamlessly without permission restrictions.
Copying game disc to secure storage…
Failed to copy game disc. Please ensure your device has at least 700 MB of free storage space.
